title: Platina - Live in Yerevan: the patch from the rental list, FULL modes (PROPOSED, 2026-11-11), 54 units on 10 universes
title_ru: Platina - Live in Yerevan: патч по списку аренды, ПОЛНЫЕ режимы (ЧЕРНОВИК, 2026-11-11), 54 прибора на 10 юниверсах
owner: N3655/N3671: every lamp in its full mode; the list is what is rented; the grandMA2 is not used for now, di sends the DMX over Art-Net (N3664).
status: PROPOSED, 2026-11-11. The counts are the rental list's. Nothing is confirmed by the rental side: maker and mode of each lamp, the node. Types with a channel count from a maker document: K10, K15, Pixel Line IP (manual copy), Magma Prime. ASSUMED: the XP-16R BWS (23 ch) - own universe, U10.
crewLine: PROPOSED, 2026-11-11, not confirmed by the rental side: read the mode on each lamp's display before setting an address.
crewLine_ru: ЧЕРНОВИК от 2026-11-11, не подтверждён арендой: перед установкой адреса прочитать режим на дисплее каждого прибора.
howToRead: docs/architecture/RIG_BUILD.md §19.5. No project document yet: the crew table comes from this plan alone — node scripts/rigbuild/patch-table.mjs --plan <this> --out <dir> --pdf. Never edit an address by hand: change the plan and print again.
method: One kind per universe where it fits (a lamp never spans two universes); every lamp in its FULL (largest) mode, no spare pitch.
Fit: K10 8 x 76 = 608 (U1 6, U2 2); K15 8 x 76 = 608 (U2 4, U3 4); hazers 2 x 5; Pixel Line IP 24 x 117 = 2808 (4 per universe, U4-U9, 468 of 512); XP-16R 12 x 23 = 276 (U10, ASSUMED).
Positions: the 11-10 ones are kept; the XP-16R positions are PROPOSED. The 3 audience-side K10 and the 7 Sharpy of 11-10 are not on the list and are not patched.

crewNotes: PROPOSED 2026-11-11. Without the ASSUMED XP-16R the patch needs 9 universes; with it, 10.

K10 and K15 'Pixel RGBW' (76 ch) is the largest mode: the maker files list pixels only (HYPOTHESIS: pan/tilt, zoom are in the other modes). Ask the rental which mode the display shows before this is set.
Pixel Line IP 117 ch: the largest in the manual copy, channel list NOT read. CO2 jets: run by the rental's operator, not patched. The grandMA2 is not used for now.
Counting: 'the audience's left' is the left as seen from the hall.
crewNotes_ru: ЧЕРНОВИК 2026-11-11. Без ПРЕДПОЛОЖЕННОГО XP-16R нужно 9 юниверсов, с ним 10.
K10 и K15 'Pixel RGBW' (76 кан.) — самый большой режим; в файлах производителя только пиксели (ГИПОТЕЗА: pan/tilt и zoom в других режимах). Спросить у аренды, какой режим на дисплее.
Pixel Line IP 117 кан.: самый большой по копии мануала, список каналов НЕ прочитан. CO2-джеты — оператор аренды, не в патче. grandMA2 пока не используется.
'Слева от зрителя' — слева, если смотреть из зала на сцену.
